question: What salvific attainment results for one who uplifts twenty-one generations of the family under the stated conditions?
premises: The preceding verses specify a particular conjunction of time and place.
Under those conditions, one uplifts twenty-one generations of the family.
Such uplift leads to a supreme attainment.
inference: Therefore, the practitioner who uplifts twenty-one generations of the family attains the supreme abode.
uncertainties: The exact sense of kula+ekaviṃśam (ancestors, descendants, or both) is not explicit in this verse alone.
plain_english: Having uplifted twenty-one generations of his family, he would go to the supreme abode.
